cards.ex: The company weathered the storm of the economic recession by cutting costs.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya xarajatlarni qisqartirish orqali iqtisodiy tanazzul qiyinchiliklarini yengib o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatni muvaffaqiyatli yengib o'tmoq, bardosh bermoq.

cards.ex: My grandmother has a green thumb; her garden is always beautiful.
cards.exUz: Buvimning bog'dorchilik qobiliyati bor; uning bog'i har doim chiroyli.
cards.uzDef: O'simliklarni yaxshi o'stirish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Despite his wealth, he's a really down-to-earth guy.
cards.exUz: Boyligiga qaramay, u juda oddiy odam.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, samimiy, tabiatga yaqin.

cards.ex: The internet has brought about a sea change in how we communicate.
cards.exUz: Internet bizning aloqa usulimizda katta o'zgarishlarga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta, sezilarli o'zgarish; tubdan o'zgarish.

cards.ex: The government has several environmental initiatives in the pipeline.
cards.exUz: Hukumatda bir nechta ekologik tashabbuslar rejalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilayotgan, tayyorlanayotgan, amalga oshirilish arafasida bo'lgan.

cards.ex: We need stronger policies to turn the tide on deforestation.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarning kesilishiga qarshi vaziyatni o'zgartirish uchun kuchliroq siyosat kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni o'z foydasiga o'zgartirish, muvaffaqiyatga erishish.

cards.ex: With rising sea levels, many coastal communities have their future at stake.
cards.exUz: Dengiz sathining ko'tarilishi bilan ko'plab sohilbo'yi jamiyatlarining kelajagi xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Xavf ostida, yo'qotish xavfi mavjud.

cards.ex: Investing in clean energy is crucial for a sustainable future.
cards.exUz: Toza energiyaga investitsiya qilish barqaror kelajak uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazmaydigan energiya manbalari.

cards.ex: Reducing food miles can significantly lower our environmental impact.
cards.exUz: Oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarining yo'lini qisqartirish bizning atrof-muhitga ta'sirimizni sezilarli darajada kamaytirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarining ishlab chiqarilgan joyidan iste'mol joyiga qadar bosib o'tgan masofasi.

cards.ex: The company aims to become carbon neutral by 2030.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya 2030 yilga qadar uglerod neytral bo'lishni maqsad qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Chiqarilgan uglerod miqdori qoplanadigan holat.

cards.ex: We need to act on the report's recommendations immediately.
cards.exUz: Hisobot tavsiyalariga zudlik bilan amal qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir narsaga javoban harakatga o'tmoq.

cards.ex: Developing countries often bear the brunt of climate change.
cards.exUz: Rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlar ko'pincha iqlim o'zgarishining asosiy zarbasini oladilar.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy og'irlikni yoki zararni o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: The environmental movement started at grass roots level.
cards.exUz: Ekologik harakat xalq orasida boshlandi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy odamlar darajasida, jamiyatning eng quyi qatlamida.

cards.ex: Climate change poses a serious threat to global food security.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi global oziq-ovqat xavfsizligiga jiddiy tahdid soladi.
cards.uzDef: Yetarli oziq-ovqat bilan ta'minlanganlik darajasi.

cards.ex: We should leave a legacy of environmental stewardship for future generations.
cards.exUz: Biz kelajak avlodlar uchun atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish merosini qoldirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak avlodlar uchun muhim iz qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: Erosion control is vital for protecting agricultural land.
cards.exUz: Eroziyaga qarshi kurash qishloq xo'jaligi yerlarini himoya qilish uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Tuproq eroziyasini oldini olish choralari.

cards.ex: We need to move away from fossil fuels to combat climate change.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishiga qarshi kurashish uchun biz qazilma yoqilg'idan voz kechishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ko'mir, neft va gaz kabi qazilma yoqilg'ilar.

cards.ex: Deforestation and soil erosion create a vicious cycle.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarning kesilishi va tuproq eroziyasi yopiq doirani yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Yomonlashuvga olib keladigan takroriy jarayon.

cards.ex: New technologies are on the horizon to help reduce emissions.
cards.exUz: Emissiyalarni kamaytirishga yordam beradigan yangi texnologiyalar ufqda.
cards.uzDef: Yaqinlashib kelayotgan, bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Activists are pushing for stricter environmental regulations.
cards.exUz: Faollar qattiqroq ekologik qoidalarni joriy etishga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir narsaga erishish uchun qat'iy harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Closing down the factory will have a ripple effect on the local economy.
cards.exUz: Zavodni yopish mahalliy iqtisodiyotga zanjir effektini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik bir harakatning katta oqibatlarga olib kelishi.

cards.ex: Sustainable agriculture is key to feeding the world's population.
cards.exUz: Barqaror dehqonchilik dunyo aholisini oziqlantirishning asosiy omilidir.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazmaydigan dehqonchilik usullari.

cards.ex: We need to take action now to prevent further environmental damage.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhitga yanada zarar yetkazilishining oldini olish uchun hozir chora ko'rishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir muammoni hal qilish uchun harakatga o'tmoq.

cards.ex: The city has launched several green initiatives to reduce pollution.
cards.exUz: Shahar ifloslanishni kamaytirish uchun bir nechta ekologik tashabbuslarni boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilishga qaratilgan tadbirlar.

cards.ex: Deforestation is happening on a massive scale in the Amazon rainforest.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarning kesilishi Amazon o'rmonida katta miqyosda sodir bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta hajmda, keng ko'lamda.

cards.ex: Farmers are at the mercy of the weather.
cards.exUz: Dehqonlar ob-havoga qaram.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir narsaning ta'siriga qaram bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: We need to put pressure on governments to address climate change.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi muammosini hal qilish uchun hukumatlarga bosim o'tkazishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir narsani qilishga majbur qilish uchun bosim o'tkazmoq.

cards.ex: Effective waste management is essential for a healthy environment.
cards.exUz: Samarali chiqindilarni boshqarish sog'lom atrof-muhit uchun zarur.
cards.uzDef: Chiqindilarni yig'ish, qayta ishlash va utilizatsiya qilish.

cards.ex: Overfishing is depleting fish stocks in the ocean.
cards.exUz: Haddan tashqari baliq ovlash okeandagi baliq zaxiralarini kamaytirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Resurslarni tugatmoq, ularni ishlatib tugatmoq.

cards.ex: Pollution and deforestation lead to environmental degradation.
cards.exUz: Ifloslanish va o'rmonlarning kesilishi ekologik buzilishga olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Atrof-muhitning sifati pasayishi.
